summary: The local municipal cadastral custodian and national geospatial catalogs were evidenced, but no safe anonymous Pucallpa parcel geometry/native-ID response was verified.
queryOutcomes: English and Spanish first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record. They identified the Municipalidad Provincial de Coronel Portillo Subgerencia de Catastro, Pucallpa Plano Regulador documents, IDEP service catalogs and INGEMMET cadastral-related services.
requestOutcomes: Municipal portal HTTP 200; official ordinance HTTP 200; IDEP WFS catalog HTTP 200; IDEP WMS catalog reached locally but web extraction was oversized; INGEMMET catalog curl stopped at TLS verification, its public zone-layer page returned HTTP 502 in web fetch, and the catastro folder timed out.
scopeLimits: No citywide open parcel coverage verified
No geometry or native parcel ID retained
Local municipal custody is distinguished from national catalog/general agency services
No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS disablement used
uncertainty: Municipal cadastral records and Plano Regulador material may exist outside public machine-readable services. Timeout, TLS validation failure, oversized catalog response, and route-specific HTTP errors do not prove citywide absence.
